name: skryvo
label: Skryvo
description: Write posts, articles, emails and listings in a brand's voice, design their pictures, and schedule them to connected channels once approved.

modules.name: writePost
modules.label: Write a post
modules.description: Drafts a post per platform in the brand's voice. Schedules nothing.

modules.name: designPicture
modules.label: Design a picture
modules.description: Designs one picture for a post in the brand's kept look, sized for each platform. Uses image credits.

modules.name: schedulePost
modules.label: Schedule a post
modules.description: Schedules approved text to connected channels. Use it only after the person approved the words.

modules.name: updatePost
modules.label: Update a post
modules.description: Moves a post that has not gone out to a new time, changes its words, or both.

modules.name: cancelPost
modules.label: Cancel a post
modules.description: Cancels a scheduled post before it goes out.

modules.name: listPosts
modules.label: List scheduled posts
modules.description: Returns scheduled and recent posts with their status.

modules.name: planArticle
modules.label: Plan an article
modules.description: Plans an article for free: headline, outline, search phrase and the questions only the person can answer.

modules.name: writeArticle
modules.label: Write an article
modules.description: Starts writing a planned article (2 generations). Watch events with Article ready, or Get an article, for the result.

modules.name: getArticle
modules.label: Get an article
modules.description: Returns an article's status: writing with its stage, done with its text and checked claims, or failed.

modules.name: publishArticle
modules.label: Publish an article
modules.description: Schedules a finished article to a connected blog, or sends it there now as a draft to review.

modules.name: writeEmail
modules.label: Write an email
modules.description: Writes subject lines, a preheader, the body and a call to action in the brand's voice. Nothing is sent.

modules.name: writeListing
modules.label: Write a product listing
modules.description: Writes a title, description and feature bullets for a marketplace from one to ten features.

modules.name: getBalance
modules.label: Get the balance
modules.description: Returns the generations, image credits and article plans left this month.

modules.name: listChannels
modules.label: List channels
modules.description: Returns the connected channels and what each one takes.

modules.name: listBrands
modules.label: List brands
modules.description: Returns the brands this key can use.

modules.name: searchContent
modules.label: Search content
modules.description: Returns earlier articles, posts, emails, listings or ads, newest first.

modules.name: watchEvents
modules.label: Watch events
modules.description: Triggers when a post is published or fails, an article is ready or fails, or a post's results come in.

modules.name: makeApiCall
modules.label: Make an API call
modules.description: Performs an authorized call to any route of Skryvo's agent API.
